headline: Last session: Indian equities fell as surging Brent crude oil prices and FII selling weighed on benchmark indices.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Surging Brent crude oil prices nearing $114 per barrel heavily pressured market sentiment.
Continued Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) selling weighed down Indian equities.
Rising geopolitical and inflation concerns snapped the market's previous weekly gains.
Periodic buying in IT stocks was insufficient to offset broad-based losses across sectors.
whatHappening: The Indian stock market is closed today, Saturday, 24 October 2026, for the weekend.
In the last trading session, Sensex dropped significantly while Nifty 50 slipped toward 22,400–22,600 levels.
Crude oil price spikes driven by global cues triggered broad market profit booking.
Normal trading will resume when the market reopens on Monday, 26 October 2026.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices closed lower as surging Brent crude oil prices and persistent FII selling created strong headwinds. The Nifty slipped toward support levels despite selective buying interest in IT counters. The stock market remains closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 26 October.
